children: Oragen announced its CMO will present clinical translation of ONP-002 and intranasal delivery progress at IPAC-RS 2026.
CMO James P. Kelly to present ONP-002 case study at IPAC-RS Nasal Innovation Forum on Sept 17, 2026.
Presentation covers ONP-002 intranasal platform, Phase IIa trial design, and anticipated U.S. development path.
Phase IIa feasibility trial is enrolling at three sites in Australia; IND submission anticipated in Q4 2026.
ONP-002 is a first-in-class intranasal neurosteroid aiming to reduce neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, and cerebral edema.
